[SASRec](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.09781) already learns selective history dependence; a recent-history residual therefore needs controls separating recency from normalization, capacity, and optimization. Recommended ablations: unchanged baseline; normalization-only control; gated full-history residual; gated recent-history residual, matching pooling, projection, normalization placement, and training settings. Use h′=h+αR(recent), α initialized to zero, adapting [ReZero’s initialization principle](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.04887). Preserve the original scoring path: adding LayerNorm after the sum changes baseline predictions even when α=0. Verify initial score equivalence. These controls are methodological recommendations, not a published SASRec-specific protocol.

For uncertainty, save paired per-user hit indicators. Resample 200 users with replacement independently within each category, using identical sampled indices for both models; compute category differences and their equally weighted macro-average. Report a 95% bootstrap interval alongside category results and discordant wins/losses. This adapts [paired resampling in retrieval evaluation](https://ciir-publications.cs.umass.edu/getpdf.php?id=744). Intervals reflect user variability conditional on seed 42 and fixed candidates; they exclude training-seed and negative-sampling variability. Preserve the pinned 99 negatives: [sampled recommendation metrics](https://research.google/pubs/on-sampled-metrics-for-item-recommendation/) can disagree with full-catalog rankings.

Repeated checkpoint and architecture selection can overfit the same 800 validation users; [Cawley–Talbot](https://www.jmlr.org/beta/papers/v11/cawley10a.html) show selection bias can rival algorithmic gains. Within 43,200 GPU-seconds, predeclare a small ablation matrix, equal training allowances, checkpoint cadence, and selection rule; record every evaluated configuration. Keep preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42. Bootstrap intervals on the selected winner do not remove selection bias. Leave splits unchanged and hidden test evaluation to the host after final selection.
